source: North Carolina State Board of Elections

c.t: Constitutional Amendment - Require Photo ID for Voting
c.q: Constitutional amendment to require all voters not just those presenting to vote in person to present photo identification before voting.

c.t: Constitutional Amendment - Maximum Income Tax Rate of 3.5%
c.q: Constitutional amendment to keep the State income tax rate from being raised higher than three and one-half percent (3.5%).

c.t: Constitutional Amendment - Property Tax Levy Limit
c.q: Constitutional amendment requiring limits on property tax increases by local governments.

c.t: Currituck Board of Education Election Method Referendum
c.q: Changing the method of election for the members of the Board of Education of Currituck County from nonpartisan to partisan.

c.t: Currituck County Local Sales and Use Tax Referendum
c.q: Local sales and use tax at the rate of one-quarter percent (0.25%) in addition to all other State and local sales and use taxes.

c.t: Currituck Board of Commissioners Structure Change Referendum
c.q: Shall the structure of the Currituck County Board of Commissioners be altered to six electoral districts whereby the qualified voters of each district shall nominate candidates and elect members who reside in the district for seats apportioned to that district and one at-large seat whereby the qualified voters of the entire county shall nominate candidates and elect members for that seat?
